## 1. File inventory — `ji-remote-bootstrap` module (all under `ji-java/products/ji-remote-bootstrap/`)

Base package `io.github.diodeme.ji.remote`, dir `src/main/java/io/github/diodeme/ji/remote/`:

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `RemoteHostInstaller.java` (363 lines) | Installer/lifecycle + argv construction + `quote()` + `serviceUnit()` + operation id/`complete` marker + rollback |
| `ProcessRunner.java` | Injectable process boundary (`run`/`runAttached`/`start`), `RunningProcess`, `Result` |
| `SystemProcessRunner.java` | JDK `ProcessBuilder` adapter (bounded timeout, discard/inherit IO) |
| `SshTarget.java` | `record SshTarget(String user, String host, int port, Optional<Path> identityFile)` → `destination()` |
| `RemoteProbe.java` | `record RemoteProbe(os, architecture, home, availableBytes, Optional<String> currentVersion)` |
| `BundleManifest.java` | Signed bundle inventory (`version/os/architecture/archiveSha256/files/signatureAlgorithm/signature`) |
| `BundleVerifier.java` | SHA-256 of archive + Ed25519 signature verify + canonical manifest → `VerifiedBundle` |
| `VerifiedBundle.java` | Verified archive + canonical manifest + its SHA-256 |
| `HcpPairingClient.java` | `PairingClient` impl; WebSocket HCP pairing with launch token (protobuf) |
| `RemoteDeviceIdentityStore.java` | Per-target Ed25519 device identity + pinned host key, `~/.ji/remote-hosts/<id>.json`, 0600 |
| `JiRemoteBootstrap.java` | CLI entry (`install` / `tunnel`), option parsing, `--user`/`--ssh-port` handling |

Tests: `src/test/java/io/github/diodeme/ji/remote/RemoteHostInstallerTest.java` (343 lines), `.../JiRemoteBootstrapTest.java` (119 lines).

## 2. SSH/SCP argv construction

`RemoteHostInstaller.java:310-322` — the single place options are built:

```java
private static List<String> sshArguments(SshTarget target) {
    List<String> command = new ArrayList<>();
    command.add("ssh");
    command.addAll(connectionArguments(target, "-p"));
    return command;
}

private static List<String> connectionArguments(SshTarget target, String portOption) {
    var arguments = new ArrayList<String>();
    arguments.addAll(List.of(portOption, Integer.toString(target.port()), "-o", "BatchMode=yes"));
    target.identityFile().ifPresent(path -> arguments.addAll(List.of("-i", path.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString())));
    return arguments;
}
```

- `ssh` calls: `sshArguments` (line 310) → `-p <port> -o BatchMode=yes [-i <path>]`, then `destination()` + `sh -c '<quoted script>'` (`RemoteHostInstaller.java:301-308`).
- `scp` calls (`:292-299`) use the **same** builder with `-P` (capital), i.e. `scp -P <port> -o BatchMode=yes [-i <path>] <src> <user@host>:<dst>`. The test pins this asymmetry (`RemoteHostInstallerTest.java:126-129`: `assertTrue(scp.contains("-P")); assertFalse(scp.contains("-p"));`).
- **`-p 22`**: port is *always* emitted, even when 22 — no `-F`, no omission. Default 22 is supplied by the CLI, not the installer: `JiRemoteBootstrap.java:99-103` (`options.containsKey("ssh-port") ? port(...) : 22`); usage string at `:140-142`.
- **`--user`**: CLI option only; the installer never emits a `--user` flag — the user is folded into the destination string, `SshTarget.java:16` `return user + "@" + host;`, so `user@host` is always explicit (this is the documented gap: overriding `~/.ssh/config` `User`/`Port`, see `docs/java-rewrite/18-client-orchestration.md:22,85-86`).
- Tunnel argv, `RemoteHostInstaller.java:205-212`:

```java
Tunnel openTunnel(SshTarget target, RemotePorts ports) {
    List<String> command = sshArguments(target);
    command.addAll(List.of("-N", "-o", "ExitOnForwardFailure=yes",
            "-L", ports.rest() + ":127.0.0.1:" + ports.rest(),
            "-L", ports.hcp() + ":127.0.0.1:" + ports.hcp(),
            target.destination()));
    return new Tunnel(List.copyOf(command));
}
```

- No `StrictHostKeyChecking` / `UserKnownHostsFile` is emitted anywhere in the installer (grep confirms it only exists in `scripts/*.ps1` and as a requirement in doc 18 §7/§92 — a known gap).
- `quote()` — `RemoteHostInstaller.java:347`: `private static String quote(String value) { return "'" + value.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'"; }` — applied to every interpolated path/script fragment; the whole script is then passed as one `sh -c` argument.

## 3. Operation id / `complete` marker / idempotency

- Operation id: `RemoteHostInstaller.java:338-340`
  ```java
  private static String operationId(BundleManifest manifest) {
      return "install-" + shellSegment(manifest.version()) + "-" + manifest.archiveSha256().substring(0, 16);
  }
  ```
  `shellSegment` (`:342-345`) restricts to `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+`.
- Path layout derived in `install()` at `:79-86`: `$HOME/.local/share/ji-host/{operations/<opId>, incoming/<opId>.tar.gz(.manifest), versions/<version>, previous, current}`.
- Remote state machine = the *reservation* script (`:87-93`), whose stdout is parsed at `:94-102`:
  - `complete` → skip everything, verify `readlink current == versions/<v>/ji-host`, re-read ports → idempotent no-upload retry.
  - `new` → fresh (`mkdir` succeeded), `resume` → directory exists without `/complete`.
- Markers written remotely: `operation/complete` (`:165-167`, only after pairing), `operation/activated` (`:136-141`), `operation/previous-target` (`:138`), `operation/ports` (`:157-158`), `operation/expected-files` / `actual-files` / `existing-files` (`:119-134`), `operation/backups-before` (`:144-147`).
- On any `RuntimeException` in the try-block (`:169-176`) → `rollback(target, current, operation)` (`:239-272`), which restores from `previous-target`, replays `.pre-v*.backup` DB files with hash-verified `cp -p` → `.restore` → `mv`, then deletes `operation/activated` and `operation/complete` (`:268-269`) so a retry re-activates. Note the test `failedActivationRetryReactivatesInsteadOfTrustingStaleMarker` covers this.
- Storage of operation state is **on the remote host only** (files under `operations/<opId>/`); there is no local/durable operation registry, no `code`+params structured error, no cancel/timeout token — see gap in doc 18 §8.

## 4. Public API surface (what a new orchestration entry would call)

```java
public RemoteHostInstaller(ProcessRunner processes)                       // :20
RemoteHostInstaller(ProcessRunner, PairingClient, Function<SshTarget,RemoteDeviceIdentityStore>) // :24 (package-private, used by tests)
public Platform probe(SshTarget)                                          // :31
public RemoteProbe inspect(SshTarget)                                     // :36
public InstallResult install(SshTarget, VerifiedBundle, Platform)         // :66
public int runTunnel(SshTarget)                                           // :198
Tunnel openTunnel(SshTarget, RemotePorts)                                 // :205 (package-private)
public record Platform(String os, String architecture, String home)        // :358
public record InstallResult(String version, String versionDirectory, String rollbackPointer, int restPort, int hcpPort) // :359
public record Tunnel(List<String> command)                                 // :362
interface PairingClient { byte[] pair(int port, String operationId, String launchToken, Identity identity); } // :352
```

Sole current caller: `JiRemoteBootstrap.install` (`JiRemoteBootstrap.java:57-83`) — `new BundleVerifier().verify(manifest, archive, publicKey)` → `probe` → `install` → JSON `{version, versionDirectory, restPort, hcpPort}`. `run(...)` overloads at `:29-34` are the test seam (takes a `Function<ProcessRunner, RemoteHostInstaller>`). There is **no host-side orchestration entry, no HTTP control-plane endpoint, and no local operation-state store** — grep for `RemoteHostInstaller` finds only these 7 files (main + 2 tests), matching doc 18 §2 "仅由 `ji-remote` CLI 驱动，未接入客户端".

## 5. Gradle module + test stubbing

- Module: `:ji-remote-bootstrap`, dir `ji-java/products/ji-remote-bootstrap` (`settings.gradle.kts:49,93`). `build.gradle.kts` uses `application` plugin, mainClass `io.github.diodeme.ji.remote.JiRemoteBootstrap`, applicationName `ji-remote`; deps `:ji-host-protocol`, `libs.jackson.databind`, `libs.java.websocket`. Wired into root `build.gradle.kts:143` (`:ji-remote-bootstrap:test`) and `scripts/verify-stage4.ps1:9`, `scripts/verify-stage4-remote.ps1:17-22`.
- **Tests never shell out to ssh** — they inject a fake `ProcessRunner` and match on joined command text:
  - `RemoteHostInstallerTest.RecordingRunner` (`:308-342`): records `run` commands into `commands`, `start` into `background`; returns canned stdout when the joined argv contains `"uname -s"` → `Linux\nx86_64\n/home/tester\n10485760\n<currentVersion>\n` (`:321`), `"printf complete"`+`"printf new"` → `reservationState` (`:323-325`), `"--launch-token"` → 43-char token (`:326`), `"; cat"`+`/ports`|`host-locator` → `rest=24191\nhcp=24192\n` (`:328-330`); `failActivation` flag makes any `--health-check` command exit 1 (`:327`).
  - `JiRemoteBootstrapTest.CliRunner` (`:86-118`) is the same shape plus `runAttached` capture (`:113-117`).
  - Pairing is stubbed via the package-private ctor: `(port, operationId, token, identity) -> new byte[44]` and `ignored -> new RemoteDeviceIdentityStore(tempFile)` (`RemoteHostInstallerTest.java:231-233, 284-286`).
  - Assertions are mostly substring checks on flattened argv (e.g. `:92-130`, `:143-178`), including ordering assertions like `activationStop < activationLocator < activationStart` (`:111-114`).
